description: This source file defines the TestClusterHostFactory class, a utility for creating and configuring Orleans silo and cluster client hosts, including setting up services, logging, and configuration serialization.

classes.name: TestClusterHostFactory
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to create Orleans silo and cluster client hosts with configurable services and settings.

methods.name: CreateSiloHost
methods.description: Creates and configures an Orleans silo host with specified name and configuration, setting environment, services, and optional post-configuration actions.

methods.name: CreateClusterClient
methods.description: Creates and configures an Orleans cluster client host with specified name and configuration.

methods.name: SerializeConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes an IConfiguration object into a JSON string for storage or transmission.

methods.name: DeserializeConfiguration
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string back into an IConfiguration object.

methods.name: ConfigureAppServices
methods.description: Configures silo-specific services based on configurator types specified in configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureClientAppServices
methods.description: Configures client-specific services based on configurator types specified in configuration.

methods.name: TryConfigureFileLogging
methods.description: Adds file logging services based on configuration setting.

methods.name: InitializeTestHooksSystemTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the TestHooksSystemTarget service to ensure its initialization.
